# YorpHives

YorpHives is an independent digital studio with free browser-local tools for writing, development, calculations, design, marketing, and security.

## Tools and agent access

- Complete tool directory: /tools/
- Machine-readable catalog: /catalog.json
- JSON formatting and campaign URL JavaScript functions: /tools/toolkit.mjs
- Additional utility functions: /tools/utility-core.mjs; export `runUtility(toolId, inputs)`
- Additional developer, business and creator utilities: /tools/everyday-core.mjs; export `runEverydayTool(toolId, inputs)`
- Local file utilities: /tools/file-core.mjs; export `processFileTool(toolId, files, options)`; image and presentation processing requires browser APIs
- Third-party library notices: /tools/vendor/README.md
- Module usage and catalog instructions: /tools/README.md

These are static browser-local tools. Agents can fetch the modules to use locally; no hosted execution API is currently provided. User inputs are not uploaded by these tools.

Contact: connect@yorphives.com
